title: My bands
subtitle: The bands you play in — on gigbuddy or not.
empty: You haven't added any bands yet.
readOnly: Someone else added this band, so only they can edit it.
claimedHint: This band is on gigbuddy now. Ask to join it to get their events automatically.

fields.name: Band name
fields.spotifyHint: Paste the artist page link from Spotify.
fields.linkHint: A Spotify link or a website is required.

errors.needsLink: Add a Spotify link or a website

add.title: Add a band

workflow.intro: Add a band by first searching for existing bands. If your band isn't on gigBuddy and has no public profile yet, you can create a new band or public band profile.

createBand.title: Create a new band
createBand.body: If you manage this band and want to invite more members. This will count towards your gigBuddy bands limit.

createProfile.title: Create a public band profile
createProfile.body: For a band you take part in, but is not (yet) on gigBuddy. You can link events to this band so you stay organized.

add.noResults: No bands found. You can add this one yourself.
add.websiteMatch: "{{name}}" already uses this website. Is that the same band?
add.inviteHelp: Got an invite code from a band on gigbuddy? Redeem it here.

full.title: This band is full
full.body: Five musicians already track this band, which is as many as a band profile holds.
full.invite: Ask to join them on gigbuddy instead, or invite the band to sign up.

editProfile.title: Edit band
editProfile.locked: This band is being claimed by its owners, so it can't be edited right now.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: This band will be removed from your list.
remove.noEvents: No events are linked to it.
remove.linked: {{count}} of your events are linked to this band.
remove.keepHint: The events stay, without a band.

leave.title: Leave {{name}}?
leave.body: You'll lose access to this band's gigs, rehearsals and files.
leave.lastAdmin: You're this band's only admin. Make someone else an admin first, or archive the band from its settings.
